source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The font size race fix makes isDefault derive from the preference or rounded OS size, updates isEdited after all registered windows, and keeps safe-mode changes in memory instead of writing a preference that would need rollback. registerWindow removes each window once on unload. The test waits for L10nMutationsFinished before checking the translated app-menu label. When changing global UI size, account for several windows, safe mode, and localization completion.
title: Keep UI font size session state separate in safe mode
